Legs.Subject: Inverse(Forward(x)) == x EXACTLY, bit-for-bit, at lengths 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 64, 256 and 1024, over the long carrier at |x| < 2^40 and the int carrier at |x| < 2^20 — two widths of the one generic network, so the IBinaryInteger<T> path is pinned at more than the width it was written against. Every step is integer addition, subtraction and an arithmetic shift, so agreement is a bit-exact identity rather than a measured bound.

ENVELOPE: the sweep keeps N * max|x| inside the carrier (2^50 of 2^63 for long at length 1024; 2^30 of 2^31 for int), so no butterfly wraps. Outside that envelope the arithmetic is unchecked and wraps modulo the carrier's width, which the member's own XML doc states as the caller's contract; nothing here observes the wrapped regime.

Forward(a) + Forward(b) == Forward(a + b) pointwise EXACTLY over the long carrier at lengths 1 through 1024 — the transform is a fixed +/-1 matrix, so linearity holds by the definition of the sum and nothing rounds.
WalshHadamardTransform.Forward over the long carrier at lengths 1 through 1024 over Pcg32XshRr-seeded content
Legs.Against: Oracles.WalshHadamardNatural — the O(N^2) definition-form sum X[k] = sum over n of x[n] * (-1)^popcount(n AND k) in BigInteger, taking each term's sign from the parity of a popcount rather than from any butterfly. The subject never forms popcount(n AND k) at all; the two share the definition and nothing else.

Legs.Subject: the comparison is EXACT equality, not a bound, and it fixes the ORDERING as Sylvester (natural): a sequency-ordered or Gray-code-ordered network agrees with this oracle at bin zero and disagrees at every other bin from length 4 up, so a wrong ordering reddens this case rather than passing it.

sum(X[k]^2) == N * sum(x[n]^2) EXACTLY in BigInteger at lengths 1 through 1024 — Parseval's identity for the unscaled Sylvester transform, whose matrix satisfies H * H = N * I. Both sides are exact integer sums of exact integer squares; a network that dropped a butterfly, doubled a lane or mis-signed a difference changes the energy and reddens this case, independently of the oracle agreement.

every documented refusal, asserted by exception TYPE and by the parameter name it reports: Forward and Inverse given an empty span or a span whose length is not a power of two (3, 5 and 6), over both the long and the int carrier — there is no plan to refuse a length at construction, so the span itself carries the refusal.
